relationships.subject: TBK1
relationships.evidence_quote: TBK1 could activate the noncanonical nuclear factor κB (NF-κB) pathway, mediate the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome, trigger microglia pyroptosis

relationships.subject: TBK1
relationships.evidence_quote: WB analysis found that the increased TBK1 activation was accompanied by elevated levels of NLRP3 inflammasome (NLRP3, ASC, and caspase-1) and cleaved IL-1β. However, the increments of these proteins were repressed by TBK1-siRNA treatment

relationships.subject: TBK1
relationships.evidence_quote: N-GSDMD was increased in the PDN + si-Scr group and decreased in the PDN + si-TBK1 group

relationships.subject: Ac-YVAD-cmk
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibiting caspase-1 could lessen pyroptosis, partially alleviating hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: Amlexanox
relationships.evidence_quote: AMX could effectively inhibit TBK1 activation

relationships.subject: Amlexanox
relationships.evidence_quote: AMX systemic application reversed the high expression of inflammatory factor, TNF-α in the spinal cord of PDN mice

key_findings: In diabetic neuropathy mice TBK1 is activated in spinal dorsal horn microglia and drives NF-kB/NLRP3/caspase-1/GSDMD microglial pyroptosis and hyperalgesia; intrathecal TBK1-siRNA reversed it.
Systemic amlexanox inhibited TBK1, reduced spinal TNF-alpha and improved peripheral nerve damage.
